prompt_vars.title: New Linux kernel LPE (Dirty Frag) — no patch yet, here's the workaround
prompt_vars.author: webnestify
prompt_vars.body: New kernel vulnerability called Dirty Frag was publicly disclosed. Universal Linux LPE, same family as Dirty Pipe. Affects every kernel from 2017 onwards. PoC public. No upstream patch yet — only a kernel-module workaround disabling esp4/esp6/rxrpc.
